annotation_context: self-contained source_times_utc per orbit and embedded target_grid

grid_transfer.drawing_policy: affine coordinate transfer; line_set geometry replaces the inherited raster at target resolution
grid_transfer.mask_policy: affinely transferred line_set geometry is rasterized at target cell centres; keyframes without line_set geometry inherit the source cell Boolean decision; valid_runs remains authoritative
grid_transfer.review_policy: boundaries and reviews are inherited from the source annotation; no new manual decisions

line_side_reference: target-grid pixel coordinates; valid_runs is authoritative
outside_source_grid: Frame classes and drawn geometry apply across the entire target grid
spherical_coordinate_system: magnetic latitude; spherical longitude = 15 * MLT (degrees), not geographic
